Biologic Treatment Outcome Predictor — CRSwNP

Dupilumab · Mepolizumab · Omalizumab
Research Tools › CRSwNP Outcome Predictor › Enter baseline parameters to compare predicted outcomes across three biologics at 3 and 6 months
Research only
For research purposes only. Predictions are generated by machine-learning models and are not validated for clinical use. They must not be used to guide individual patient care or treatment selection.

Baseline Parameters

Enter the patient's pre-treatment features. The same inputs are run through each biologic's best model (Elastic Net / Random Forest / XGBoost per outcome) to predict SNOT-22, nasal polyp score (TNPS) and blood eosinophils at 3 and 6 months.

Enter baseline parameters on the left and click Run Comparison
to see predicted outcomes for all three biologics side by side.

⚠ Research use only. These predictions are model estimates with substantial uncertainty (cross-validated R² varies by outcome and is shown on each metric). They do not constitute medical advice and must not replace clinical judgment. Blood eosinophil predictions reflect expected on-treatment values; some biologics transiently raise eosinophils.

To use your own trained models, replace the MODELS object in the script with the contents of your model_<treatment>.json files from export_models.py. Feature order is read from each model file automatically.
